ndvi.dataset: NASA MODIS Terra monthly NDVI (MOD13C2 family), via NASA GIBS

lst.dataset: NASA MODIS Terra monthly daytime land surface temperature (MOD11C3 family), via NASA GIBS

evap.dataset: NASA GMAO MERRA-2 monthly land evaporation (evapotranspiration), via NASA GIBS

provenance.method: colour-mapped pixels turned back into values with each layer’s GIBS colour map (the middle of each colour class); median of the 3×3 pixels (0.05°) round each point
